lines.text: Watch: we link 8 pictures into one funny story.
riding a giant wheel, round and round.
At the very top, the whale drops its ice cream.
Splat! It lands on a camera.
The camera starts spraying water, like a fountain.
The fountain fills an envelope with water.
A rooster grabs the dripping envelope...
and plants it in a flower pot.
Now replay the story once in your mind.
